scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @variable-island/shared build && pnpm --filter @variable-island/naming-core build && pnpm build:main && concurrently -k "vite --config vite.renderer.config.ts --host 127.0.0.1" "tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on tcp:5174 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5174 electron dist/main/main.js"
scripts.build: pnpm clean:dist && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && vite build --config vite.renderer.config.ts
scripts.pack:win: pnpm build:deps && pnpm build:native-helper && pnpm build && electron-builder --win --dir
scripts.dist: pnpm build:deps && pnpm build:native-helper && pnpm build && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.dist:win: pnpm build:deps && pnpm build:native-helper && pnpm build && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.zip:win: pnpm build:deps && pnpm build:native-helper && pnpm build && electron-builder --win zip
